svg.text: Actual NIFTY index candles | Times IST, start labels | A frozen, B author-corrected, C gap-candle candidate | Ledger overlays only
5-minute: full previous session + full current session
1-minute: first hour; only first five rows form the ORB candle
Opening O 25696.05 H 25742.65 L 25679.20 C 25729.85; body 53.27% | Manual direction / level / entry price UNKNOWN.
Gold band: first 5m. Purple: PDH/PDL. Orange: assumed inner levels. Dashed teal/magenta: assumed LONG/SHORT trendlines. Circles: ledger fills. Crosses: ledger leg exits.
Ledger exits are model fills; on target gaps the existing model keeps the target level, which can lie outside that minute bar.
LONG Method 1: previous_level_close, trend, quality; signed close distance -61.45
LONG Method 2: trend, trendline, quality; signed close distance 14.20
LONG Gap/200DMA: gap_crossing, quality; signed close distance 7.74
SHORT Method 1: previous_level_close, quality; signed close distance -125.75
SHORT Method 2: inner_close, trendline, quality, near_ma; signed close distance -81.55
SHORT Gap/200DMA: gap_direction, gap_crossing, ma_close, quality; signed close distance -7.74
